title: TextRefine: Improving Textual Fidelity, Spatial Placement, and Glyph Rendering for Text Editing in Product Posters
abstract: Text editing in product posters entails inserting new text or replacing existing text while preserving product appearance, background content, and global composition. Despite recent progress in instruction-based image editing, general-purpose models remain unreliable in this setting: they often omit or incorrectly render the target text, place it over salient products or pre-existing content, and produce structurally distorted or visually inconsistent glyphs. We introduce \textbf{TextRefine}, a task-aligned post-training framework that combines supervised fine-tuning with operation-specific reward optimization to address these complementary failure modes. For text insertion, our text-span-level reward jointly assesses semantic fidelity and target-span coverage, penalizes spatial conflicts with products and existing text, and employs a gated structural constraint to preserve non-text regions. For text replacement, our glyph-level reward leverages the connectionist temporal classification (CTC) posterior of the target character to provide graded supervision for fine-grained defects, including missing strokes, structural deformations, and confusion among visually similar characters. We further introduce \textbf{OpenTextEdit}, a dataset comprising 100K images for text editing in product posters, with multi-text layouts, detailed text attributes, product masks, and challenging low-frequency characters. Extensive experiments on both insertion and replacement demonstrate that TextRefine consistently outperforms the evaluated image editing baselines in textual fidelity, placement reliability, and glyph quality while better preserving source-image content.

analysis.sourceNote: 依据 exact version 2608.19637v1 全文整理；本地 PDF 共 19 页，SHA-256 6c43c5b8705e47cb88843734af63131f711b6998356459618b7ebeb2b8d3af9e，并视觉核验第 1、3、7、8 页。
analysis.ideaZh: TextRefine 为poster text insertion设计span fidelity、coverage、spatial conflict与gated preservation rewards，为rare-character replacement设计CTC glyph posterior；作者报告simple insertion match 91.9%、miss 3.8%，rare-character accuracy 74.5%。
methodFlow: 检测poster文字/产品并构造insertion/replacement pairs
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 对Image Generation中的text editing和2D Design的layout/glyph fidelity有直接迁移价值，但域较窄。
analysis.evidenceZh: OpenTextEdit pipeline分别构造insertion与rare-character replacement数据，并配套operation-specific rewards。（Figure 2 and Methodology, p. 3）；作者报告simple-template insertion match 91.9%、miss 3.8%，localized rare-character replacement accuracy 74.5%。（Tables 1-4, p. 7）；评估局限OpenTextEdit、Chinese single-character replacement和PaddleOCR-v5；多语、多字符与外部poster distribution未知。（Conclusion, p. 7）
analysis.caveatZh: 作者明确指出外部、多语、多字符setting尚未覆盖。；评估局限OpenTextEdit、Chinese single-character replacement和PaddleOCR-v5；多语、多字符与外部poster distribution未知。；所有实验数字均为作者报告；本项目没有独立复现。
analysis.motivationZh: 论文针对text editing中遗漏、遮挡产品、破坏背景和glyph变形，构建100K OpenTextEdit与task-specific SFT+DiffusionNFT RL。插入任务按target span与non-target layout给reward，替换任务以CTC posterior提供graded character supervision。两类benchmarks与reward ablations显示收益，但数据集中于product posters和Chinese low-frequency characters，外部/多语/多字符设置未测。
analysis.methodZh: 把span-level semantic/layout约束和glyph-level graded posterior分开，避免单一OCR binary reward无法定位字符结构错误。 方法流程：检测poster文字/产品并构造insertion/replacement pairs → VLM恢复target spans与text attributes → SFT建立task-aligned editing policy → span/spatial/preservation reward优化text insertion → CTC glyph posterior优化localized replacement。
analysis.experimentsZh: 约100K training images；insertion 629 simple+1235 descriptive samples，replacement 200 rare-character samples；FID/SSIM/PSNR、match/partial/miss与accuracy。 作者报告：作者报告simple-template insertion match 91.9%、miss 3.8%，localized rare-character replacement accuracy 74.5%。（Tables 1-4, p. 7） Baseline coverage：与Qwen-Image-Edit-2511、FireRed-Image-Edit-1.0及SFT/RL controls比较；没有人工审美/user study或更广layout benchmark。 Ablation：逐项移除span、gated SSIM、binary OCR与glyph posterior rewards，支持不同failure modes需不同credit。
analysis.insightZh: 把span-level semantic/layout约束和glyph-level graded posterior分开，避免单一OCR binary reward无法定位字符结构错误。 reward design与结果清晰，因poster/中文单字特化和无代码，收录为skim。
